# Figure spec — core biosynthetic domain burden (`core_biosynthetic_domain_burden.png`)

**Generated by:** `mamey.domain_figures.render_domain_figures` (Figure B).
**Source table:** `domain_level/domain_complexity_metrics_by_bgc.csv`.

## Purpose
A stacked horizontal bar per top-lead BGC, splitting **biosynthetic-core** domains from
**accessory/other** domains. Surfaces which leads have real assembly-line support versus
accessory clutter — the architecture-confidence axis Mode B needs alongside AB/AF.

## Layout rules
1. One bar per BGC, node/contig-first label.
2. Two segments: biosynthetic core (`core_color`) then accessory/other (`accessory_color`)
   from `domain_figure_specs.v1.json`.
3. Sorted by core domain count, descending.
4. Legend above the axes; x-axis is domain count.

## Companion outputs
`core_biosynthetic_domain_burden_data.csv` (BGC, core, accessory, total) + manifest row.
